seo.title: Dar Zaytoun — Mediterranean Restaurant in Marseille
seo.description: Dar Zaytoun is a Mediterranean table in the heart of Marseille: mezze, tagines and grilled fish, seasonal produce and olive oil from our partner groves. Book your table online.

hero.title: Dar Zaytoun
hero.tagline: The house of the olive tree: generous cooking that connects both shores of the Mediterranean, from Tunis to Valencia.
hero.image_alt: A Moorish arch opening onto the sea at sunset, framed by an olive branch.

about.title: Food for sharing, born under the olive tree
paragraphs: “Zaytoun” means olive in Arabic. Chef Leïla Mansour built Dar Zaytoun around this tree: a house where plates are shared the way stories are.

Every morning we cook with produce from the market, fish from the harbour auction and cold-pressed olive oil from our partner groves. Our recipes travel between the Maghreb, Greece, Andalusia and Provence, never forgetting the taste of simple things.
about.image_alt: Illustration of an old olive tree with gnarled branches, framed by an arch.

menu.title: Flavours from both shores
menu.intro: A short menu that changes with the seasons. Our dishes are made to be shared in the middle of the table.
menu.note: Prices in euros, service included. Allergen information available on request: please let us know about any intolerance.

mezze.name: House mezze
mezze.desc: Hummus, smoky aubergine moutabal, parsley tabbouleh and warm pita bread.

fattoush.name: Fattoush salad
fattoush.desc: Crunchy vegetables, radish, toasted bread, sumac and pomegranate molasses.

brick.name: Egg brik
brick.desc: Crisp pastry, runny egg, tuna, capers and mild harissa.

calamari.name: Grilled squid
calamari.desc: Chermoula, preserved lemon and roasted chickpeas.

tagine.name: Lamb tagine
tagine.desc: Slow-cooked for seven hours with prunes, toasted almonds and sesame seeds.

couscous.name: Seven-vegetable couscous
couscous.desc: Hand-rolled semolina, broth scented with ras el hanout.

sea_bream.name: Grilled gilt-head bream
sea_bream.desc: Fresh from the harbour, roasted fennel, virgin olive oil and fresh herbs.

chicken.name: Chicken m'hammer
chicken.desc: Free-range chicken with preserved lemon, purple olives and melting potatoes.

baklava.name: Pistachio baklava
baklava.desc: Filo pastry, Aleppo pistachios and orange blossom syrup.

mhalabia.name: Rose mhalabia
mhalabia.desc: Milk pudding scented with rose water, pistachios and petals.

oranges.name: Cinnamon oranges
oranges.desc: Orange segments, cinnamon, fresh mint and dates.

gazelle.name: Gazelle horns & tea
gazelle.desc: Almond pastries served with mint tea.
